preset.text: The goal is to get rid of all your cards. You MUST play the rank requested on your turn. But you can lie about what cards you are actually putting down!
If you think someone is lying, click the 'Call BS?' deck during the 7 second window! If they lied, they take the whole pile. If they told the truth, YOU take the pile!
